description: This Java source file defines the InterestRateChartDataValidator class, responsible for validating JSON requests related to interest rate charts in the Apache Fineract project. It includes methods for validation during create and update operations, handling JSON parsing, parameter validation, and delegating validation of chart slabs.

classes.name: InterestRateChartDataValidator
classes.description: A Spring component class providing validation logic for interest rate chart data JSON requests, ensuring required parameters are present and correctly formed.

methods.name: validateForCreate
methods.description: Validates the JSON payload when creating a new interest rate chart, checking required fields and loading chart slabs for further validation.

methods.name: validateForCreate
methods.description: Performs detailed validation of create request JSON, including parameter presence, date logic, and nested chart slabs validation.

methods.name: validateUpdate
methods.description: Validates the JSON payload when updating an existing interest rate chart, ensuring parameters are valid and present as needed.

methods.name: validateForUpdate
methods.description: Performs detailed validation of update request JSON, including checks on optional and required parameters, date validation, and nested chart slabs.
